summary: Correctness population authority is invocation provenance, not measured host isolation. A pure resolver admits accepted authority only for the acceptance entry point with the workflow's required-check signal; other invocations remain diagnostic, and a CI run missing the signal fails visibly. Exact effects bind every population; zero escaped busy additionally binds the accepted population. Shared provenance and host-load support for unrelated read P99 proof remain.
title: Conformance population authority is invocation provenance, not measured host isolation
